title: Senior Quality Engineer - SDET
description:
Strength in Trust 

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge

We are looking for a Senior level SDET to support our product development teams. As the Principal SDET, you will play a crucial role in shaping and leading our software testing strategy. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing robust test automation frameworks, mentoring a team of SDETs (Software Development Engineer in Test), and ensuring the overall quality and reliability of our software products. 

Your Mission

As a Senior SDET, you will: 

- Provide technical leadership and guidance to the SDET team.

- Collaborate with development and QE (Quality Engineering) teams to integrate testing into the software development process.

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable and efficient test automation frameworks and test architectures.

- Rub shoulders with developers in writing unit and integration tests using their tools and frameworks.

- Ensure the frameworks support various testing types, including functional, integration, and performance testing.

- Mentor and guide junior SDETs, providing technical expertise and career development support.

- Conduct training sessions to enhance the skills of the testing team.

- Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning within the team.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop comprehensive test plans.

- Execute and oversee the execution of test cases, ensuring thorough coverage of functional and non-functional requirements.

- Analyze test results and provide meaningful insights to improve product quality.

- Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and user stories.

- Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, providing clear updates on testing progress and issues.

- Add, maintain, and update scripts in existing automation suite, helping with running the suite across various checkpoints in the release cycle. 

- Participate in various POCs (Proof of Concept) to keep the automation framework and technology relevant and current to product offerings. 

- Conduct peer reviews of test code and automation frameworks. 

You Are

- You are a seasoned SDET with an automate anything anywhere attitude who is looking for a challenging technical leadership role in a dynamic and innovative company.

- You can efficiently find the underlying cause of a failure (in an integrated environment) and alert the right team.

- You are consistently willing to pitch in to support a long running deployment, even after hours.

- You are willing to learn and pick up new skillsets to support the ever-changing technology landscape like Cloud computing & AI (Artificial Intelligence).

- You can understand complex product and deployment architectures and create efficient test solutions.

- You want to be part of a team that is passionate about delivering high-quality software solutions.

Your Experience Includes 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical or business field. 

- 4+ years of relevant experience working as a developer, automation engineer or SDET. 

- 4+ years of experience coding in Java and must have strong practical knowledge of OOPs and Core Java principles. 

- 4+ years of experience contributing to Test-Driven Development or BDD (Behavior Driven Development) with tools like Cucumber, Junit, Mockito, or TestNG.

- 3+ years of experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Circle CI, or Azure DevOps with the ability to create test pipelines using Java or Groovy.

- 4+ years of experience with Selenium or Cypress frameworks for automating GUI (User Interface) and E2E tests of the application.

- 4+ years of experience with REST Assured or similar tools like Postman for automating APIs.

- 4+ years of experience working in a highly automated CI/CD environment. 

- 4+ years of experience with source control tools such as Bitbucket, GitHub or GitLab. 

- 2+ years of experience mining meaningful logs for troubleshooting using tools like Splunk, Dynatrace or Coralogix.

- 3+ years of experience working in a cloud shop preferably Azure with exposure to various Azure services like Gateways, Redis, Storage, VMs (virtual machines) and Kubernetes clusters. 

- 3+ years of experience in testing mobile applications, both native and websites using Appium on both real devices and simulators either in a private farm of 3rd party vendors like Sauce Labs or BrowserStack.

- 4+ years of experience working with geographically distributed teams in US, Canada, and India. 

- Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work as part of a team, demonstrate initiative, solve problems independently and mentor others.

- Passion for high quality work and attention to detail.

- Strong oral and written communication skills.

Extra Awesome

- Prior exposure to AI/ML systems and how to use them in testing thus making test pipeline more intelligent.

- Experience in analyzing the CPU Utilization, Memory usage, Network usage, Garbage Collection and DB Parameters and DB Reports to verify the performance of the applications.

- Ability to spin up scalable test architecture using Docker or Kubernetes.

- Experience with Kubernetes and extended usage patterns for test grids, auto scale properties.

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources 

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: 

- OneTrust Careers on YouTube

- @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.

Our Commitment to You 

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.

Senior Test Automation Quality Engineer

Job summary

The Senior Test Automation Quality Engineer owns automated quality for a data platform and a data analytics platform. The platform keeps many partner integrations, and those integrations feed the dashboards and reports partners use. This role works with Engineering on requirements, designs, schedules, and release risk. The engineer uses AI coding agents in the Cursor and Claude ecosystem to speed up test authoring, review, and failure analysis, and keeps a human in the loop for assertions, coverage, and release decisions.

What you will do

- Design and maintain automated tests for partner integrations, the pipelines that land their data, and the dashboards and reports built from that data.

- Cover the path from source system to published report: ingest, transform, warehouse or lake, then the dashboard and report the partner sees. Include schema, row presence, freshness, and reconciliation across systems.

- Turn manual cases and acceptance criteria into stable automation in Java, Python, or Go. Use Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium for dashboard and report UI, and an API framework for integration and data services.

- Prove that a new or changed integration does not break existing partner dashboards and reports. Call out which reports, datasets, and partners a failure affects.

- Build these checks on AWS (for example S3, Glue, Athena, Lambda, Step Functions, and IAM) and against the warehouse the analytics platform uses.

- Use Cursor and Claude agents to draft tests, page objects, and triage notes from requirements and failures. Review every generated assertion before it is merged.

- Execute suites in CI, diagnose failures, and separate product defects from test defects and flakes. File defects with evidence: pipeline, query, dashboard, and report.

- Write and maintain test plans, cases, procedures, and release reports. Plan test scope against delivery dates when several integrations ship together.

- Review integration designs and report requirements for gaps, risk, and testability before build starts.

- Define quality gates for release readiness: an integration is not ready while its dashboards or reports are wrong, empty, or stale.

- Review historical results, call out regressions in shared datasets that fan out to many reports, and recommend changes to standards and coverage.

- Partner with Engineering and Quality Engineering in an agile delivery model. Explain findings so the team knows which partner experience is at risk.

What you bring

- Proven experience as a senior test automation or quality engineer, including ownership of suites through release.

- Experience on a data platform or analytics platform with multiple integrations, where partner dashboards and reports depend on that data.

- Proficiency with AI coding agents, specifically the Cursor and Claude ecosystem: skills, rules, prompts, and review of agent-written tests.

- Strong programming in at least one of Java, Python, or Go, and the ability to read the others.

- Hands-on UI automation with Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium, plus REST API automation.

- Solid AWS experience for data pipelines and analytics workloads. Secrets stay in a secret store, never in tests or logs.

- Experience testing web and API systems that depend on a database, warehouse, or lake.

- Skill in test design, defect isolation, and release reporting, with a high bar for assertion quality.

- Clear writing for test plans, bug reports, and quality summaries that name the affected reports and partners.

Preferred

- Experience with more than one UI tool (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium) or more than one language (Java, Python, Go).

- CI ownership (GitLab CI or GitHub Actions), including artifacts, quality gates, and pipeline triage.

- Hands-on checks for schema compare, row counts, and freshness, and for warehouses such as Snowflake or Athena.

- Experience validating scheduled or exported reports (PDF, email, or scheduled dashboard delivery), not only the on-screen dashboard.

title: Sr QA Engineer - Espresso, Kotlin, Roborazzi, JUnit, Git Actions & Android
description:
Scope:
- Contribute as a QA engineer for supply chain SaaS products with a particular focus on store-based kiosk dropoffs for returned retail goods. Support best practices across automation, test planning, execution, metrics, and release readiness.
- Develop, maintain, and improve automation frameworks and test suites for Returns workflows, APIs, integrations, and critical customer-facing capabilities.
- Work with other product development teams to improve test coverage for returns initiation, tracking, notifications, disposition decisions, inventory visibility, warehouse returns processing, and related reverse logistics workflows.
- Partner with Product Management, Platform Engineering, UX, Cloud Operations, Support, and implementation teams to help deliver high-quality software aligned to roadmap commitments and customer outcomes.

Our current technical environment:
- Software: Kotlin, Android, MongoDB, Amplitude, Sentry
- Hardware: Custom Android-based kiosks, scanners, printers, and sensors with proprietary SDKs.
- Automation Framework: Espresso, JUnit, Selenium WebDriver, Robolectric
- DevOps: AWS, Azure, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Sauce Labs, Firebase, JFrog, Postman
- Architecture: Scalable, resilient, service-oriented architecture, distributed, asynchronous, offline-first, high availability.

What you’ll do:
- Apply QA automation and performance testing practices; provide input on options and recommendations as needed.
- Develop, maintain, and improve automation frameworks, reusable scripts, and test suites.
- Determine test scenario priorities, create execution plans, and support coverage for critical features.
- Create clear, comprehensive test plans, test procedures, test cases, and automation documentation.
- Estimate, prioritize, plan, and coordinate testing activities across functional, regression, API, database, performance, PSR, and security testing.
- Design, develop, execute, and analyze automated tests using open-source tools and CI/CD best practices.
- Identify, document, track, and help resolve defects; perform regression testing when issues are fixed.
- Partner with developers, product managers, UX, and cloud teams to clarify requirements, improve product quality, and support release readiness.
- Investigate causes of non-conforming software, monitor debugging results, and recommend practical solutions.
- Track QA metrics such as automation progress, defect density, open defects, execution results, and release readiness.
- Share knowledge with QA engineers on automation frameworks, testing standards, tools, and best practices.
- Stay current with new testing tools, libraries, and test strategies.

What we are looking for:
- BE/B.Tech, ME/M.Tech, MCA, or related degree with 5–8 years of experience in QA automation, software development, or quality assurance for large enterprise applications.
- Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools, processes, and Agile/Scrum development practices.
- Hands-on experience developing and maintaining automation frameworks such as Espresso, Kotlin, Roborazzi, JUnit, Git Actions & Android
- Knowledge of modern web development practices, OOP concepts, git, and branching strategies.
- Prior experience testing and introspecting Android devices in a live runtime environment using remote debugging tools.
- Familiarity with accessibility standards and testing best practices.
- Experience testing web applications, RESTful services, APIs, databases, and complex enterprise workflows.
- Solid SQL skills and experience with Oracle, PostgreSQL, or similar relational databases.
- Experience with test management, defect tracking, reporting, and CI/CD tools such as Jira, Spira, Zephyr, Xray, Allure, Jenkins, Postman, or similar tools.
- Hands-on experience with white box, black box, functional, regression, automation, performance, and security testing.
- Experience working with white-label products and complex configuration environments.
- Ability to install and configure relevant products, troubleshoot issues, and provide practical inputs to development teams.
- Supply chain domain knowledge; returns, warehouse, inventory, logistics, commerce, or reverse logistics experience preferred.
- Strong problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and continuous improvement skills.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:
Under summary section
Zettle India, part of PayPal's Payment Services and Crypto organization, is hiring a Software Engineer in Test (SDET). Our POS platform moves real money for merchants every day across mobile apps, cloud services, and card readers. In this hands-on role, you'll turn designs into written risk models before code exists, build automated checks that gate real merges, and encode how the payments domain behaves so the knowledge outlives any one person. You'll help shape how test engineering works on a platform where quality is built in, not bolted on. If you'd rather build the thing than maintain it, read on — the best is yet to come!
Job Description:
Essential Responsibilities: 
- Implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), receiving structure and oversight from more experienced staff
- Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures
- Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions
- Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions
- May contribute to code & design reviews

Minimum Qualifications:
- 1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

What you need to know about the role: 
 
PayPal POS sits at the heart of how many SMBs run their businesses every day. Card payments, card readers and hardware variance, acquiring, payments SDKs, ledger and financial flows, onboarding and checkout across web and mobile. As a Test Engineer here, you won't hand down verdicts after the fact; you'll build the capability that lets verification happen without you in the room. The engineering discipline bar is the same as any software role: version control, review in both directions, CI, design before implementation, and root-cause debugging by the owner. The Test Engineer will be integral part of the team and takes pride in advocating for the quality of the Zettle mobile app on Android and iOS, along with the backend and web services behind it.
 
Meet our team: 
 
Zettle is PayPal's point-of-sale and payments product for small businesses. Zettle India is part of the Payment Services and Crypto organization, and our test engineering team supports the Zettle mobile app on Android and iOS and the services behind it. We are a centralized Test and Quality Engineering function actively moving to an automation-first, shift-left culture. You will be joining a growing team and help shape its test strategy, automation framework, and quality standards. You will partner closely with developers and product managers, and mentor engineers in the team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, with three days a week onsite. 
 
Your way to impact: 
 
As a Test Engineer, you will help make sure that merchants can take payments without problems on any device. You will own testing for the features you work on, from test planning to release, and you will help move our testing from manual to automated over time. Your work will reduce production defects, speed up releases, and improve the experience of small businesses that use Zettle every day. You will grow toward a Senior Test Engineer role as you build your technical depth and ownership. 
 
In your day-to-day role you will be responsible for: 

- Understand requirements and design test cases, test scenarios, and end-to-end tests for Zettle mobile app features on Android and iOS.
- Write and merge automated cross-service / interop tests into CI/CD pipelines that gate real merges; debug every failure to root cause.
- Perform manual and exploratory testing on real devices, emulators, and simulators across OS versions, screen sizes, and network conditions.
- Test APIs and backend services using Postman or RestAssured and validate data using SQL queries.
- Run tests on BrowserStack and in CI/CD pipelines (Harness) and analyze failures to find the root cause.
- Log clear, reproducible defects in JIRA with logs (Logcat, Xcode), screenshots, and screen recordings, and follow them through to closure.
- Maintain test cases and test runs in TestRail, and report test status and risks to the team. Reduce flaky tests and suggest ideas to improve test coverage, speed, and quality.
- Exposure to contract testing, mutation testing, or AI-assisted quality practices (AI-generated test case review, test gap analysis)
 
What do you need to bring: 

- 2-4 years of experience in software testing, with at least 1-2 years in mobile (Android and/or iOS) testing.
- Hands-on experience with Espresso and/or XCUITest, with willingness to learn the other.
- Good Java programming fundamentals and basic knowledge of data structures.
- Experience with API testing (Postman, RestAssured) and writing SQL queries.
- Good understanding of SDLC/STLC, test design, and defect management using JIRA and TestRail.
- Familiarity with Jenkins, BrowserStack, and debugging tools such as Logcat and the Xcode console.
- Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work with developers and product managers.
- Ownership, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.
- Nice to have: Appium, Kotlin or Swift reading ability, mobile performance testing (Android Profiler, Xcode Instruments), JMeter, AWS, and experience in payments or FinTech.

Subsidiary:
PayPal
Travel Percent:
0

PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. Job Summary:
Zettle India, part of PayPal's Payment Services and Crypto organization, is hiring a Senior Software Engineer in Test (Sr. SDET). Our POS platform moves real money for merchants every day across mobile apps, cloud services, and card readers. In this hands-on role, you'll lead test strategy and native automation with Espresso and XCUITest for a product that small businesses use every day to take payments. You'll help shape how test engineering works on this platform, with scope that goes well beyond what the title usually buys. If you want the mandate without waiting in line for it, read on — the best is yet to come!
Job Description:
Essential Responsibilities: 
- Delivers complete solutions spanning all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) (design, implementation, testing, delivery and operations), based on definitions from more senior roles.
- Advises immediate management on project-level issues
- Guides junior engineers
- Operates with little day-to-day supervision, making technical decisions based on knowledge of internal conventions and industry best practices
- Applies knowledge of technical best practices in making decisions

Minimum Qualifications:
- 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

What you need to know about the role: 

The Senior Test Engineer will be responsible for the end-to-end quality of the Zettle mobile app on Android and iOS, along with the backend and web services behind it. In this role, you will work with Android, iOS, and backend developers and product managers to define the test strategy, build and scale automation, set quality gates for releases, and guide the team on testing best practices. The ideal candidate has 5-8 years of experience in test engineering, strong hands-on mobile automation skills, solid Java and framework design skills, and a keen eye for risk in payments products. 

Meet our team: 

Zettle is PayPal's point-of-sale and payments product for small businesses. Zettle India is part of the Payment Services and Crypto organization, and our test engineering team supports the Zettle mobile app on Android and iOS and the services behind it. We are a centralized Test and Quality Engineering function actively moving to an automation-first, shift-left culture. You will be joining a growing team and help shape its test strategy, automation framework, and quality standards. You will partner closely with developers and product managers, and mentor engineers in the team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, with three days a week onsite.

Your way to impact:

You will be the test engineering voice inside POS feature teams from the earliest stage, authoring journey-level test strategy before development starts and influencing designs before they harden. You'll own suites that gate real merges and keep them trusted, and triage that reaches root cause. When a defect escapes to production, you'll run the escape analysis and land the change that closes the loop between outcome and design. Your impact will be felt in the reliability of the POS product, the maturity of the teams around you, and the standard the whole function is measured against. 

In your day-to-day role you will be responsible for: 

- Own domain test suite end to end: in CI/CD, gating merges, flake held under target.
- Own the test strategy and test plans for Zettle mobile app releases on Android and iOS, using a risk-based approach.
- Lead manual and exploratory testing on real devices, emulators, and simulators across OS versions, screen sizes, and network conditions.
- Run escape analysis on production defects you own, and land the change that closes the loop between outcome and design.
- Lend a hand to the payments certification teams: structured evidence gathering and verification-report support. You support certification; you don't own it.
- Design, build, and scale automation frameworks using Espresso (Android) and XCUITest (iOS), following the Page Object pattern and best practices for stable tests.
- Test APIs and backend services using RestAssured or Postman, and validate data with SQL queries.
- Guide and support other test engineers on the team, reviewing test code and sharing automation best practices.
- Suggest and drive improvements in test processes, tools, and automation coverage, including the adoption of AI tools. 

What do you need to bring:

- 5-8 years of experience in software testing, with at least 3 years in mobile (Android and/or iOS) test automation.
- Solid hands-on expertise in mobile automation for iOS and Android (XCUITest, Appium, Espresso, UIAutomator, or equivalent), plus API and service-level testing (REST/gRPC) for distributed systems.
- Ability to operate with minimal day-to-day supervision, make sound technical decisions within your domain, and proactively surface risks to stakeholders.
- Experience with API and backend testing (RestAssured, Postman) and SQL, plus CI/CD experience with Harness and device clouds such as BrowserStack.
- Strong knowledge of SDLC/STLC, risk-based testing, test planning, and defect management using JIRA and TestRail.
- Experience debugging mobile issues with Logcat, Xcode logs, and network tools, and handling production issues and hotfixes.
- Clear communication and the ability to work with developers, product managers, and other teams, and to mentor less experienced engineers.
- Ownership, accountability, and a habit of improving how the team tests.

Get Bonus Points With:
- Experience building test capability in a new team or org, not just maintaining an existing one
- Experience with Mobile Performance Testing (Android Profiler, Xcode Instruments), JMeter, AWS, app store release experience.
- Payments, fintech, or regulated domain experience (acquiring, ledgers, PCI scope, risk engines)
- Hardware-in-the-loop testing: card readers, terminals, firmware variance, offline payment behavior
- Familiarity with payment certification practices — PCI MPoC, EMV Level 3, structured test evidence and verification reports.

Non-functional & AI quality:

Defect management:

Test automation:

- Strong coding skills in TypeScript/JavaScript and/or Python. Writes clean, maintainable test code using Page Object Model, fixtures and data-driven patterns.
- Solid API testing: REST, HTTP, JSON and auth (OAuth2/JWT) using pytest/requests, Postman/Newman or REST Assured.
- Experience integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLabCI or Jenkins) with parallel execution and reporting.

QA fundamentals:
- Strong grasp of functional, regression, smoke, integration, end-to-end, exploratory and UAT testing, and of test design techniques (boundary values, equivalence partitioning, decision tables).

- Docker basics, plus hands-on experience with at least one performance testing tool (k6, JMeter or Locust).

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
About Us
We're rebuilding vertical software with AI — from the inside.

Embrace owns the software running inside 16% of the Fortune 500, 45+ state agencies, and 450+ banks and credit unions. We acquire entrenched vertical software businesses and rebuild them around AI — products, operations, go-to-market, all of it. Our Venture Lab launches new AI-native products into those same markets, using the distribution and customer relationships our portfolio already owns.

You'll ship AI into production against real workflows, real customers, and a P&L you can see move within a quarter.

We hire people who want scope, speed, and ownership, and who are tired of working on AI that never reaches a customer. If you want to spend the next five years shipping into software that already runs the economy, talk to us. 

Job Description
This is a remote position.

Embrace Healthcare Group powers some of the most innovative healthcare technology solutions in North America, with a focus on enhancing clinical efficiency and compliance across emergency care settings.

EPOWERdoc, a leading SaaS platform within the Embrace Healthcare Group portfolio, specializes in Emergency Department Information Systems (EDIS) tailored for hospitals of all sizes. Designed by clinicians for clinicians, EPOWERdoc streamlines emergency room documentation with intuitive workflows, customizable templates, peer-reviewed clinical content, and real-time coding assistance—helping providers reduce documentation time and focus more on patient care.

We’re looking for a Senior QA Engineer to build EPOWERdoc’s next-generation quality engineering practice, AI-native from day one. This is a hands-on builder role: you’ll choose and architect our test automation stack, write much of the code yourself, and use AI coding agents every day to design, generate, maintain, and triage tests.

You’ll also own how we test AI itself. You’ll design the evaluation harnesses and guardrails that show EPOWERdoc’s AI-powered capabilities are accurate, safe, and dependable enough for an emergency department. You’ll partner closely with developers, product managers, designers, and clinical content experts.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead QA strategy: Own the end-to-end quality strategy for EPOWERdoc, defining test plans, risk-based coverage goals, and quality gates for every release.
- Architect the QA tech stack: Evaluate, select, and document the tooling for UI, API, performance, accessibility, and security testing, recording each decision and its trade-offs in architecture decision records.
- Build automation and expand coverage: Design and maintain scalable test frameworks for web applications, APIs, and integrations. Set standards clear enough that engineers and AI agents can extend them reliably. Use these frameworks to replace manual regression with automated coverage of critical clinical workflows such as triage, documentation, orders, and discharge.
- Performance and reliability: Build load, stress, and soak tests that model real emergency department peak volumes, establish performance baselines, and catch regressions before they reach production.
- Own CI/CD quality: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so every pull request and build is validated quickly. Use parallel execution and AI-assisted test impact analysis to keep feedback loops short as the suite grows.
- Defect management: Work with engineering teams to identify, document, prioritise, and resolve defects early in the development lifecycle, and drive root-cause analysis.
- Exploratory testing: Lead exploratory testing of new features and complex clinical user flows, combining human judgement with AI-driven exploration where automation alone adds less value.
- Agile partnership: Bring a quality perspective to sprint planning, refinement, and retrospectives, including estimates, acceptance criteria, and release readiness.
- Quality advocacy: Champion a quality-first culture from code reviews to release management. Report on quality metrics and trends such as escaped defects, flakiness, and test cycle time.
- Security and compliance: Ensure testing practices, test data, and the use of AI tools meet HIPAA and healthcare data security standards, with no real PHI in test environments or AI prompts.

AI-NATIVE QUALITY ENGINEERING
AI is part of how this team works every day. In this role you will:
- AI-assisted test design: Use LLMs to turn user stories, acceptance criteria, and clinical specifications into test scenarios, edge cases, and boundary conditions, then review and sharpen them with sound test-design judgement.
- Agentic test authoring: Use AI coding agents and Playwright’s MCP server and test agents (planner, generator, and healer) to create and maintain automated tests. Hold generated code to the same review and quality bar as production code.
- Self-healing and failure triage: Apply AI to locator healing, flaky-test detection, and automated failure analysis: clustering failures, summarising likely root causes, and routing defects to the right owner.
- Synthetic test data: Make realistic, PHI-free synthetic patient records and clinical scenarios the default for functional, performance, and AI evaluation testing, using tools such as Synthea or LLM-driven generators.
- Testing AI features: Design evaluation frameworks for AI-powered EPOWERdoc capabilities. These include golden datasets, scoring rubrics, LLM-as-judge grading calibrated against human review, and regression gates that run whenever a model, prompt, or knowledge source changes.
- AI safety and guardrails: Test AI features for hallucination, clinical and coding accuracy, bias, PHI leakage, prompt injection, and graceful failure. Work with clinical experts to define what “good enough for the ED” means in measurable terms.
- Measure and share impact: Track how AI changes test authoring time and maintenance effort, and share what works with other Embrace engineering teams.

THE STACK YOU’LL SHAPE
This is our starting point, not a mandate. You’ll own the final decisions and the reasoning behind them.
- UI and end-to-end: Playwright with TypeScript, including visual regression and automated accessibility checks (axe-core).
- API and integration: Playwright API testing, contract testing (for example Pact), and validation of HL7 and FHIR interfaces.
- Performance: Locust or k6 for load, stress, and soak testing.
- Security: OWASP ZAP and dependency scanning in CI, plus the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications as the baseline for AI features.
- AI tooling: AI coding agents (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor), Playwright MCP and test agents, and LLM evaluation frameworks such as Promptfoo, DeepEval, or Ragas, with tracing through Langfuse or LangSmith.
- CI/CD and reporting: Tests running on every pull request, with Allure or a similar dashboard for trends, flakiness, and release readiness.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
- First 30 days: You understand EPOWERdoc’s clinical workflows, existing test assets, and release process. You’ve proposed the target QA stack and AI-native approach as written architecture decision records.
- By 90 days: Playwright smoke and regression suites cover the most critical clinical workflows and run on every pull request. A performance baseline exists for peak load. AI-assisted test authoring is in daily use with measured results.
- By 6 months: Manual regression effort is a small fraction of today’s. Flaky tests are tracked and trending down. An evaluation harness gates every release of AI-powered features.

Requirements
- Experience: 5+ years of professional QA or software testing experience, including at least 3 years building test automation, ideally in a SaaS or web application environment.
- QA foundations: Solid understanding of QA methodologies, risk-based testing, test design techniques, and software development life cycles.
- Programming: Strong coding skills in TypeScript or JavaScript and working proficiency in Python. You write test code with the same care as production code.
- Test automation: Hands-on experience with modern automation tools, with Playwright strongly preferred (Cypress or Selenium also considered). This includes building scalable frameworks from the ground up, managing test data, keeping suites stable and fast, and a record of well-reasoned tooling decisions.
- AI-native practice: Daily use of AI coding agents in test engineering, with examples you can walk us through, and the judgement to spot when AI output is wrong or shallow.
- Testing AI systems: Understanding of how LLM features fail and how to test non-deterministic outputs with eval datasets, rubric or model-based grading, and pass thresholds.
- Performance testing: Hands-on experience with Locust, k6, JMeter, or similar tools, including designing realistic workload models and interpreting the results.
- API and CI/CD: Solid experience with API testing, CI/CD tools, and Git, and with running automated suites within build pipelines.
- Communication and ownership: Ability to explain quality risks clearly to engineers, product managers, and leadership, with strong analytical skills and a proactive, self-starter attitude.
- Ways of working: Experience working in a highly remote, fast-paced, and agile environment across time zones.
- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Nice to have
- Healthcare experience: Work in healthcare or health tech, especially EHR, EDIS, or other regulated clinical software (for example, ONC Health IT certification testing). This includes familiarity with HL7 v2, FHIR, and HIPAA requirements for test data and environments.
- AI tooling experience: Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation and observability tools, or building MCP servers and custom AI agents for engineering teams.
- Security and accessibility testing: Experience testing web and AI applications, including prompt-injection testing, red-teaming, and WCAG.

Benefits
- Competitive salary aligned with UK working hours, ensuring fair and transparent compensation.
- Global Team Collaboration—work alongside extremely talented professionals from around the world.
- Professional Growth Support with access to training programs designed to enhance your skills and expand your knowledge.
- Clear Career Progression and excellent opportunities for long-term advancement within the organization.
- Comprehensive Health Benefits to support your wellbeing and peace of mind.
- Flexible Remote Work Options that empower you to balance work and life effectively.

As a Senior QA Engineer, you will take ownership of quality engineering across an innovative AI-powered healthcare platform, working at the intersection of large language models, voice automation, and cloud-native technologies. You will design and implement comprehensive testing strategies to ensure the reliability, accuracy, and performance of intelligent workflows used in patient access and healthcare operations. From validating AI-generated responses and voice synthesis pipelines to building scalable automated testing infrastructure, your work will directly influence product quality and user experience. Collaborating closely with product, engineering, and AI teams, you will embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle. You will also help establish testing standards, mentor other QA professionals, and continuously improve engineering practices. Accountabilities

You will lead quality assurance across web applications, APIs, AI-powered features, and cloud infrastructure, ensuring robust testing practices and reliable product releases.

- Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites using Playwright for web applications, APIs, and AI-generated content workflows. 
- Lead quality assurance strategies for voice automation pipelines built with ElevenLabs, creating test cases to evaluate speech synthesis quality, latency, reliability, and failure scenarios. 
- Validate Claude (Anthropic) integrations by testing prompt-response accuracy, edge-case handling, safety behaviors, and output consistency across releases. 
- Develop and maintain Node.js-based testing tools, custom test runners, service mocks, command-line utilities, and reporting systems using TypeScript and JavaScript. 
- Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot scalable test infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), leveraging Cloud Run, Google Cloud Storage (GCS), Pub/Sub, and related services. 
- Integrate automated testing frameworks into CI/CD pipelines to support reliable, efficient, and continuous software delivery. 
- Define, monitor, and improve quality metrics, including test coverage, test flakiness rates, mean time to detect issues, and regression testing velocity. 
- Perform API-level testing across REST, WebSocket, and gRPC protocols to validate system functionality, integration reliability, and performance. 
- Develop testing strategies that account for the non-deterministic nature of AI systems, including prompt regression testing and evaluation of LLM-generated outputs. 
- Collaborate with engineering teams during architecture and design reviews to identify testability gaps and promote observable, fault-tolerant system design. 
- Investigate, diagnose, and resolve complex testing issues across AI integrations, voice workflows, APIs, and cloud environments. 
- Establish team-wide QA standards covering test authoring, code reviews, automation maintenance, and testing best practices. 
- Mentor junior QA engineers, sharing technical expertise and supporting their professional development. 
- Continuously improve testing processes, automation coverage, and quality engineering practices across the platform. 

Requirements

The ideal candidate combines senior-level QA engineering experience with strong software development skills and practical knowledge of AI, voice technologies, and cloud infrastructure. You should be comfortable building sophisticated automation frameworks and evaluating systems whose outputs may vary between executions.

- At least 5 years of professional experience in Quality Assurance Engineering or Software Test Engineering. 
- At least 2 years of experience testing systems involving Large Language Models (LLMs), AI APIs, or speech and audio processing pipelines. 
- Expert-level proficiency with Playwright, including building resilient selectors, managing parallel test execution, and diagnosing flaky tests at scale. 
- Strong Node.js development skills, with experience building custom test runners, CLI tools, service mocks, and automation utilities using TypeScript or JavaScript. 
- Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform, particularly deploying workloads through Cloud Run or GKE, querying Cloud Logging, and managing artifact storage in GCS. 
- Familiarity with ElevenLabs or comparable text-to-speech (TTS) and voice APIs, including synthesis parameters, webhook workflows, and audio quality evaluation. 
- Practical experience testing Claude or other LLM integrations, including prompt regression testing, output evaluation, edge-case validation, and determinism-aware testing strategies. 
- Strong understanding of REST, WebSocket, and gRPC protocols for API and integration testing. 
- Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Google Cloud Build, or equivalent tools. 
- Knowledge of software testing methodologies, test automation architecture, regression testing, and quality metrics. 
- Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities, with the capacity to investigate complex technical issues and communicate findings clearly. 
- Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively alongside product, engineering, and AI teams. 
- A proactive and autonomous approach to problem-solving, with strong ownership of quality standards and delivery outcomes. 

Additional Skills That Are a Plus

- Experience designing custom LLM evaluations or working with evaluation frameworks such as PromptFoo or Braintrust. 
- Background in audio signal quality assessment, speech intelligibility testing, or voice synthesis evaluation. 
- Familiarity with observability tools such as OpenTelemetry, Datadog, or Google Cloud Monitoring. 
- Knowledge of accessibility testing standards, particularly WCAG 2.1, and compatibility with assistive technologies. 
- Experience working with AI-powered healthcare products or healthcare workflow automation platforms. 

Core Technology Stack

- Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Cloud Run, Google Cloud Storage (GCS), Pub/Sub, Cloud Logging, and GKE for scalable testing infrastructure. 
- ElevenLabs: Voice automation testing, text-to-speech pipeline validation, synthesis quality evaluation, webhook testing, and latency monitoring. 
- Node.js / TypeScript: Custom test runners, service mocks, CLI tooling, and CI/CD integration. 
- Playwright: End-to-end browser automation, API testing, and parallel test execution. 
- Claude (Anthropic): LLM integration testing, prompt regression analysis, and AI output evaluation. 

Benefits

- Competitive base salary aligned with experience and technical expertise. 
- Fully remote working opportunity in India. 
- Flexible paid time off policy. 
- High-autonomy working environment with direct access to executive leadership. 
- Structured operating cadence with clearly defined goals, performance metrics, and career growth targets.

title: AI Evals Engineer [SDET]
description:
About the Role:

We are looking for a hands-on AI Evals Engineer to own how we measure, validate, and continuously improve the quality of our NLP, ML, Generative AI, and Agentic AI capabilities. You will design and build evaluation frameworks, datasets, and automated quality gates that give engineering and product teams real confidence before and after every release. This is a deeply technical, build-first role. You will write code every day: eval harnesses, LLM-as-judge pipelines, test datasets, and CI/CD integrations. A background in test automation and quality engineering, combined with strong AI fundamentals, is the ideal profile. 

What 'll be Responsible for?

- Design and build end-to-end evaluation frameworks for LLM-powered features, RAG pipelines, copilots, and multi-step agents.
- Create and curate high-quality evaluation datasets: golden sets, adversarial and edge-case sets, synthetic data, and production-derived regression sets, with clear versioning and labeling guidelines.
- Define task-specific quality metrics and rubrics covering accuracy, groundedness, hallucination, relevance, safety, toxicity, bias, latency, and cost.
- Build and calibrate LLM-as-judge pipelines, and validate them against human annotation (agreement, bias, and drift analysis).
- Evaluate agentic systems: tool-use correctness, planning and reasoning quality, trajectory analysis, task completion, error recovery, and guardrail adherence.
- Run red-teaming and robustness testing: prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, and adversarial inputs.
- Integrate evals into CI/CD as automated quality gates, with regression detection across model, prompt, and retrieval changes.
- Set up online and offline monitoring for production quality: sampling, drift detection, feedback loops, and alerting.
- Partner with ML engineers, product managers, and developers to translate product requirements into measurable, testable quality criteria.
- Analyze failures, perform root-cause analysis, and turn findings into actionable recommendations for models, prompts, and system design.
- Mentor SQE1 and SQE2 engineers, and contribute to evaluation standards, best practices, and reusable internal tooling.

What We'll look in you?

Technical Skills (Must-Have)

- 6 to 10 years of experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or SDET roles, with at least 1 to 2 years on AI/ML or LLM-based products.
- Strong hands-on programming in Python; working knowledge of one more language such as Java, TypeScript, or Go is a plus.
- NLP: tokenization, embeddings, semantic similarity, text classification, summarization, and NER; classical metrics such as BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore, and their limitations.
- Machine Learning: supervised and unsupervised learning, train/validation/test methodology, overfitting, data leakage, and metrics such as precision, recall, F1, AUC, and calibration.
- Generative AI: transformer and LLM concepts, prompting techniques, fine-tuning vs. RAG, context windows, sampling parameters, hallucination, and non-determinism.
- Agentic AI: agent architectures, tool/function calling, planning and memory, multi-agent orchestration, and protocols such as MCP.
- Practical experience designing evals for LLM applications: datasets, rubrics, LLM-as-judge, pairwise comparison, and human-in-the-loop review.
- Strong test automation foundations: framework design, API and service testing, CI/CD integration (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar), and test data management.
- Working knowledge of statistics for evals: sampling, confidence intervals, significance testing, inter-annotator agreement, and handling non-deterministic outputs.
- 
Preferred Skills (Good-to-Have)
- Hands-on experience with eval and observability tools such as Promptfoo, DeepEval, Ragas, LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, TruLens, OpenAI Evals..
- Experience with LLM and agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or the Claude and OpenAI SDKs.
- Familiarity with vector databases and retrieval evaluation (recall@k, MRR, nDCG, context precision and recall).
- Experience with AI safety and security testing: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, red-teaming, and guardrail validation.
- Exposure to MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model registries, data versioning, and production monitoring.
- Experience with performance, load, and cost testing of LLM-backed services.
- Background in Playwright, Selenium, Appium, REST Assured, pytest, or similar automation stacks.
- Cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) experience.
- Domain exposure to telecom, messaging, or CPaaS platforms is an added advantage.
Behavioral Competencies
- Strong analytical thinking; turns ambiguous quality problems into clear, measurable engineering solutions.
- High ownership and ability to work independently while driving cross-team alignment.
- Excellent written and verbal communication; explains eval results and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Curiosity and a bias for learning in a fast-moving AI landscape.

Why join us?
- Impactful Work: Play a key role in strengthening HR operations and delivering a seamless employee experience across the organisation.
- Tremendous Growth Opportunities: Be part of a rapidly growing company with opportunities to build and improve HR processes and practices.
- Innovative Environment: Work alongside a collaborative team in a dynamic environment where ownership, accountability and innovation are valued.

description:

Amagi is an Emmy®-winning, agentic industry cloud platform powering the modern video economy. We help media companies unify streaming and broadcast workflows, modernize operations, and maximize monetization—from live remote production and real-time ad decisioning to automated playout and global content syndication.
Trusted by a majority of the world's top 50 listed media companies, Amagi delivers:

We power marquee brands including CBS, BBC, Warner Bros. Discovery, NBC, NBA, and DAZN—and the world's biggest events: The Olympics, Super Bowl, The Grammys, and the US Presidential Debate.
Amagi is built on the belief that freedom and happiness are essential for people to do their best work. We call it the Amagi Way: a unique DNA of goodness, purpose, and innovation that shapes how we work, the teams we build, and the impact we want to make together. Over the last two decades, it has been the driving force behind how we have redefined the video economy while contributing to the communities around us. 
Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, and listed on the BSE and NSE, Amagi is a global team of 1,000+ people spread across offices in the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.
To learn more about our impact, we invite you to explore here.

Location : Bengaluru (Bannerghatta Road)

Role Overview:
Amagi's Customer Experience team delivers 40 to 50 linear channels every week to OTT, FAST, cable and smart-TV platforms around the world, and every delivery is quality-checked before it goes live. Today much of that QA is done by people watching streams for hours and checking EPG and metadata by hand. As an Onboarding Automation Engineer, you will design and build, from scratch, the automated testing system that does this work: a scalable, API-driven platform that checks video, audio, subtitles, ads, EPG and metadata the way a viewer would experience them.
This is a software development role, not a manual testing role. You will build the system that the QA team uses, and you will own its adoption. You will sit within the QA team, work with Python, AWS, FFmpeg, OpenCV and AI models, and partner with delivery engineers, product and engineering. Within your first six months, the goal is a fully functioning system that tests video, SSAI, EPG and metadata for at least four tier-1 platforms.

What will you own?
1/ Automated Delivery QA Platform
- Design and build, from the ground up, an API-driven automated testing system that validates every linear channel delivery before it goes live.
- Define the test catalogue and pass/fail metrics with the QA team, and turn the requirements of close to 600 distribution platforms into configurable, reusable test cases, starting with tier-1 platforms such as Samsung TV Plus, LG Channels and Roku.
- Build pre-QA checks that catch stream, configuration and metadata errors before a delivery reaches QC, raising the first-time QA pass rate.
- Make the system easy for the QA and delivery teams to adopt: self-service test runs, clear reports, and integration with the tools they already use, such as Jira and Slack.

2/ Video, Audio, and Ad Validation
- Detect visual defects the way a viewer sees them: black or frozen frames, pixelation and macroblocking, visible interlacing and other on-screen artefacts, using OpenCV and vision models rather than relying only on stream metadata.
- Build accurate, cost-effective detection of audio-video sync drift, where PTS timestamps alone cannot be trusted, along with missing or silent audio, channel layout and loudness issues.
- Validate closed captions and subtitles: presence, on-screen position, and timing against the audio.
- Validate SSAI and monetisation: SCTE-35 markers, ad break signalling, and whether ad replacement actually happens in the delivered stream.
- Check HLS and DASH streams against each platform's requirements: renditions, bitrates, codecs, resolution and manifest structure.

3/ EPG and Metadata Validation
- Automate EPG and metadata checks across XMLTV, JSON and platform-specific formats: schedules, ratings, languages and required fields.
- Use OCR and vision models to validate artwork, for example whether an image carries the required title treatment, and whether titles and descriptions match what is actually playing.
- Bring existing validation scripts, such as the Roku EPG framework and the pre-QA checks on the delivery board, into the common platform.

4/ Scalable, Cost-Efficient Infrastructure
- Architect the system on AWS so it scales out with delivery volume (40 to 50 channels a week and growing) and scales back when there is nothing to test.
- Process many concurrent streams efficiently, choosing between CPU, GPU, OpenCV and hosted AI models (for example through Amazon Bedrock) based on accuracy and cost per test.
- Containerise and deploy services with Docker, Kubernetes or serverless components, managed as infrastructure as code, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins).
- Add monitoring, alerting and logging so that failures in the platform itself are found and fixed quickly.

5/ Quality, Performance, and Reliability
- Measure the accuracy of every automated check against human QA results, and drive down false positives and false negatives so the QA team trusts the system.
- Analyse recurring delivery and QC failures, and turn them into new tests and pre-checks.
- Keep historical reports and artefacts (HTML, JSON, recordings) for audit and debugging.
- Own the stability of the platform, maintaining 99.9% uptime.

6/ Collaboration and Reporting
- Work with the QA lead and delivery engineers to prioritise test cases by business impact and platform.
- Track progress against a 30-60-90 day plan and give regular updates to your manager.
- Document the system and its APIs so other teams can add tests and plug it into their own workflows.

What are we looking for?
- 2-5 years of software development experience, with a track record of building backend systems or automation frameworks from scratch, not only writing test scripts.
- Strong hands-on programming experience in Python, including services, APIs and concurrent processing.
- Hands-on experience with video and audio analysis tools such as FFmpeg/FFprobe, MediaInfo and OpenCV.
- Working knowledge of streaming technologies: HLS, DASH, SRT, codecs, bitrates and adaptive renditions.
- Familiarity with server-side ad insertion (SSAI) and SCTE-35, or the ability to learn them quickly.
- Experience designing scalable, cost-efficient systems on AWS (EC2 Auto Scaling, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, SQS), and familiarity with AWS Media Services.
- Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar), Git and Jenkins or equivalent CI/CD tools.
- Experience using AI/ML models, OCR, vision models or LLM APIs in production, and the judgement to know when they are accurate and cheap enough to use.
- Experience with REST APIs, JSON/XML schema validation, and a relational database such as PostgreSQL.
- Experience with monitoring and observability tools.
- The ability to reason about a problem from first principles, for example how to detect audio-video sync issues from the viewer's side, and propose a practical, cost-effective solution.
- Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to give regular status updates.
- Ownership mindset and the ability to work independently on a greenfield system in a fast-paced environment.
- Customer-focused mindset: you understand that a defect your system misses reaches a customer's viewers.
- Good to have: experience with broadcast, OTT or FAST delivery, EPG formats such as XMLTV, smart-TV platforms or device test labs, and test frameworks such as Pytest or Robot Framework.

title: QA Engineer
description:
About Ginesys

Ginesys is India's leading retail technology platform, powering 1,200+ customers and 50,000+ users through the unified GinesysOne suite — ERP, Cloud POS (Zwing), Order Management (Browntape), GST Compliance (EaseMyGST), and BI (InsightX). We are evolving from a System of Records to a System of Intelligence through Ginesys.AI.

About The Role

Ginesys Insights 2.0 is a self-service analytics platform for retail. Users build workbooks with pivot grids, charts and calculated measures, then share, schedule and export them as CSV, Excel or PDF. Every number must match the Ginesys ERP, and every customer must see only their own data.

We need a QA Engineer who can test both the user experience of the platform and the correctness of the reports built on it. You'll understand how data travels from the ERP database through the ingestion pipeline to each report, so you can tell a UI bug from a data or pipeline problem.

What You'll Do

Platform UI and UX

- Test the full user experience end to end:
- the workbook builder; grids, pivots, subtotals and grand totals; filters, drill-down and calculated measures; charts and dashboards;
- saved views, the content library and folders; sharing and access requests; scheduling and email delivery;
- CSV, XLSX and PDF exports; notifications; the admin screens.
- Check usability and compliance with the design system, responsive and mobile layouts, cross-browser behaviour, accessibility (WCAG), Indian number and date formatting, and the empty, loading, error and "stale data" states.

Reports and data correctness

- Reconcile report numbers against Ginesys ERP native reports and the source PostgreSQL database using SQL.
- Cover sales, returns, net sales, footfall and conversion %, tender and payment collection, closing, transit and in-store stock position, and stock ageing.
- Check the edge cases: channel definitions (wholesale, retail POS, e-commerce, SOR/SIS); soft-deleted and cancelled transactions; as-of inventory carried forward between snapshots; division by zero; numeric precision and rounding; totals matching detail rows.
- Validate exported files against what is on screen.

Security and multi-tenancy

- Test role-based access, row-level security (for example site restrictions), column masking, Viewer vs Contributor seats, certified vs custom content, and SSO session behaviour.
- Run negative tests to prove one customer can never see another customer's data.

Pipeline- and infrastructure-aware testing

- Understand the data flow: ERP PostgreSQL, then Debezium/Kafka CDC, then the BigQuery raw layer, then Dataform silver and gold, then Cube and the backend, then the UI.
- Test data freshness: a change in the ERP should appear in the report within the agreed time. Also test late, updated and deleted records, and the effect of new source columns.
- Use Dataform assertion results, pipeline logs and Cloud Run logs to find where a defect starts. Confirm which build or revision is deployed in each environment before testing.

Automation, performance and release

- Build and maintain automated tests:
- Playwright end-to-end tests for critical user journeys;
- API tests against the backend contract (Postman/Newman or REST Assured);
- SQL-based data-reconciliation checks, all running in GitHub Actions.

We are recruiting for **QA Practice Leader**

  

**Location:** Chennai DLF IT Tech Park

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

  

**Mode of work :** Work from office

  
  

**About the Role**

  

Photon is looking for an experienced **QA Practice Leader** to build, scale, and run our Quality Assurance practice across engagements. This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role responsible for defining QA standards, methodologies, and tooling across projects, while also owning talent development, client engagement, and delivery excellence for the QA function. The ideal candidate has led QA/testing organizations at scale in a services or product environment and is equally comfortable in front of clients, in front of a whiteboard architecting a test strategy, and in front of a team coaching them to raise the bar.

  

**What You'll Own**

  

**Practice Strategy & Standards**

  

* Define and evolve Photon's QA practice vision, methodology, standards, and playbooks (manual, automation, performance, security, accessibility testing)
* Establish reusable frameworks, accelerators, and tooling that can be applied across client engagements
* Drive adoption of modern QA approaches: shift-left testing, risk-based testing, test automation pyramids, AI-assisted testing, and continuous testing in CI/CD
* Set and track quality KPIs/metrics (defect leakage, test coverage, automation ROI, cycle time) across accounts

  

**Delivery Leadership**

  

* Provide QA leadership and governance across multiple concurrent client engagements/projects
* Review test strategies, test plans, and automation architectures for critical accounts
* Act as an escalation point for quality risks, release readiness, and production defect trends
* Partner with delivery, engineering, and product leaders to embed quality early in the SDLC

  

**Team & Talent**

  

* Build, mentor, and grow a high-performing QA organization (SDETs, manual testers, automation engineers, performance/security testers, QA leads)
* Define career paths, competency frameworks, and training/certification programs
* Drive hiring strategy and interview standards for QA roles across the organization
* Foster a culture of quality ownership across engineering, not just within QA

  

**Client & Business Engagement**

  

* Serve as the QA subject-matter expert in client discussions, proposals, and account reviews
* Support pre-sales: solutioning, effort estimation, and QA components of RFPs/RFIs
* Identify opportunities to expand QA services within existing accounts and win new business
* Represent Photon's QA capability in industry forums, client workshops, and thought leadership

  

**Innovation & Tooling**

  

* Evaluate and introduce test automation frameworks, tools, and platforms (e.g., Selenium/Playwright, Appium, JMeter/k6, Cypress, API testing tools)
* Champion AI/ML-driven testing (test generation, self-healing automation, intelligent defect triage)
* Build internal accelerators, IP, and reusable assets that differentiate Photon's QA offering

  

**What You Bring**

  

* 18+ years of overall QA/testing experience, with 5+ years in a QA leadership role managing multi-project or practice-level scope
* Proven experience building or scaling a QA practice within an IT services, consulting, or product engineering organization
* Strong grasp of test automation architecture, CI/CD integration, and modern testing frameworks across web, mobile, and API layers
* Experience with performance, security, and accessibility testing disciplines
* Track record of managing distributed QA teams (200+ engineers) across multiple accounts/geographies
* Client-facing experience: presales support, account governance, executive-level communication

**Nice to Have**

  

* Experience with AI-powered testing tools or building AI/GenAI-based QA accelerators
* Certifications: ISTQB (Advanced/Expert level), CSTE, or equivalent
* Experience in specific verticals relevant to Photon's client base (e.g., retail, BFSI, healthcare, media)

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

**Job Summary:**

Zettle India, part of PayPal's Payment Services and Crypto organization, is hiring a Senior Software Engineer in Test (Sr. SDET). Our POS platform moves real money for merchants every day across mobile apps, cloud services, and card readers. In this hands-on role, you'll lead test strategy and native automation with Espresso and XCUITest for a product that small businesses use every day to take payments. You'll help shape how test engineering works on this platform, with scope that goes well beyond what the title usually buys. If you want the mandate without waiting in line for it, read on — the best is yet to come!

**Job Description:**

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Delivers complete solutions spanning all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) (design, implementation, testing, delivery and operations), based on definitions from more senior roles.
* Advises immediate management on project-level issues
* Guides junior engineers
* Operates with little day-to-day supervision, making technical decisions based on knowledge of internal conventions and industry best practices
* Applies knowledge of technical best practices in making decisions

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications****:**

**What you need to know about the role:**

  
  

The Senior Test Engineer will be responsible for the end-to-end quality of the Zettle mobile app on Android and iOS, along with the backend and web services behind it. In this role, you will work with Android, iOS, and backend developers and product managers to define the test strategy, build and scale automation, set quality gates for releases, and guide the team on testing best practices. The ideal candidate has 5-8 years of experience in test engineering, strong hands-on mobile automation skills, solid Java and framework design skills, and a keen eye for risk in payments products.

  
  

**Meet our team:**

  

Zettle is PayPal's point-of-sale and payments product for small businesses. Zettle India is part of the Payment Services and Crypto organization, and our test engineering team supports the Zettle mobile app on Android and iOS and the services behind it. We are a centralized Test and Quality Engineering function actively moving to an automation-first, shift-left culture. You will be joining a growing team and help shape its test strategy, automation framework, and quality standards. You will partner closely with developers and product managers, and mentor engineers in the team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, with three days a week onsite.

  
  

**Your way to impact:**

  
  

You will be the test engineering voice inside POS feature teams from the earliest stage, authoring journey-level test strategy before development starts and influencing designs before they harden. You'll own suites that gate real merges and keep them trusted, and triage that reaches root cause. When a defect escapes to production, you'll run the escape analysis and land the change that closes the loop between outcome and design. Your impact will be felt in the reliability of the POS product, the maturity of the teams around you, and the standard the whole function is measured against.

**In your day-to-day role you will be responsible for:**

  
  

* Own domain test suite end to end: in CI/CD, gating merges, flake held under target.
* Own the test strategy and test plans for Zettle mobile app releases on Android and iOS, using a risk-based approach.
* Lead manual and exploratory testing on real devices, emulators, and simulators across OS versions, screen sizes, and network conditions.
* Run escape analysis on production defects you own, and land the change that closes the loop between outcome and design.
* Lend a hand to the payments certification teams: structured evidence gathering and verification-report support. You support certification; you don't own it.
* Design, build, and scale automation frameworks using Espresso (Android) and XCUITest (iOS), following the Page Object pattern and best practices for stable tests.
* Test APIs and backend services using RestAssured or Postman, and validate data with SQL queries.
* Guide and support other test engineers on the team, reviewing test code and sharing automation best practices.
* Suggest and drive improvements in test processes, tools, and automation coverage, including the adoption of AI tools.
  

  

**What do you need to bring:**

  
  

* 5-8 years of experience in software testing, with at least 3 years in mobile (Android and/or iOS) test automation.

* Solid hands-on expertise in mobile automation for iOS and Android (XCUITest, Appium, Espresso, UIAutomator, or equivalent), plus API and service-level testing (REST/gRPC) for distributed systems.
* Ability to operate with minimal day-to-day supervision, make sound technical decisions within your domain, and proactively surface risks to stakeholders.
* Experience with API and backend testing (RestAssured, Postman) and SQL, plus CI/CD experience with Harness and device clouds such as BrowserStack.
* Strong knowledge of SDLC/STLC, risk-based testing, test planning, and defect management using JIRA and TestRail.
* Experience debugging mobile issues with Logcat, Xcode logs, and network tools, and handling production issues and hotfixes.
* Clear communication and the ability to work with developers, product managers, and other teams, and to mentor less experienced engineers.
* Ownership, accountability, and a habit of improving how the team tests.
  

  

**Get Bonus Points With:**

* Experience building test capability in a new team or org, not just maintaining an existing one
* Experience with Mobile Performance Testing (Android Profiler, Xcode Instruments), JMeter, AWS, app store release experience.
* Payments, fintech, or regulated domain experience (acquiring, ledgers, PCI scope, risk engines)
* Hardware-in-the-loop testing: card readers, terminals, firmware variance, offline payment behavior
* Familiarity with payment certification practices — PCI MPoC, EMV Level 3, structured test evidence and verification reports.

PayPal

0

PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam.
