We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

**Job Summary:**

Under summary section
  
Zettle India, part of PayPal's Payment Services and Crypto organization, is hiring a Software Engineer in Test (SDET). Our POS platform moves real money for merchants every day across mobile apps, cloud services, and card readers. In this hands-on role, you'll turn designs into written risk models before code exists, build automated checks that gate real merges, and encode how the payments domain behaves so the knowledge outlives any one person. You'll help shape how test engineering works on a platform where quality is built in, not bolted on. If you'd rather build the thing than maintain it, read on — the best is yet to come!

**Job Description:**

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), receiving structure and oversight from more experienced staff
* Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures
* Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions
* Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions
* May contribute to code & design reviews

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications****:**

**What you need to know about the role:**

PayPal POS sits at the heart of how many SMBs run their businesses every day. Card payments, card readers and hardware variance, acquiring, payments SDKs, ledger and financial flows, onboarding and checkout across web and mobile. As a Test Engineer here, you won't hand down verdicts after the fact; you'll build the capability that lets verification happen without you in the room. The engineering discipline bar is the same as any software role: version control, review in both directions, CI, design before implementation, and root-cause debugging by the owner. The Test Engineer will be integral part of the team and takes pride in advocating for the quality of the Zettle mobile app on Android and iOS, along with the backend and web services behind it.

**Meet our team:**

Zettle is PayPal's point-of-sale and payments product for small businesses. Zettle India is part of the Payment Services and Crypto organization, and our test engineering team supports the Zettle mobile app on Android and iOS and the services behind it. We are a centralized Test and Quality Engineering function actively moving to an automation-first, shift-left culture. You will be joining a growing team and help shape its test strategy, automation framework, and quality standards. You will partner closely with developers and product managers, and mentor engineers in the team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, with three days a week onsite.

**Your way to impact:**

As a Test Engineer, you will help make sure that merchants can take payments without problems on any device. You will own testing for the features you work on, from test planning to release, and you will help move our testing from manual to automated over time. Your work will reduce production defects, speed up releases, and improve the experience of small businesses that use Zettle every day. You will grow toward a Senior Test Engineer role as you build your technical depth and ownership.

**In your day-to-day role you will be responsible for:**

  
  

* Understand requirements and design test cases, test scenarios, and end-to-end tests for Zettle mobile app features on Android and iOS.

* Write and merge automated cross-service / interop tests into CI/CD pipelines that gate real merges; debug every failure to root cause.
* Perform manual and exploratory testing on real devices, emulators, and simulators across OS versions, screen sizes, and network conditions.
* Test APIs and backend services using Postman or RestAssured and validate data using SQL queries.
* Run tests on BrowserStack and in CI/CD pipelines (Harness) and analyze failures to find the root cause.
* Log clear, reproducible defects in JIRA with logs (Logcat, Xcode), screenshots, and screen recordings, and follow them through to closure.
* Maintain test cases and test runs in TestRail, and report test status and risks to the team. Reduce flaky tests and suggest ideas to improve test coverage, speed, and quality.
* Exposure to contract testing, mutation testing, or AI-assisted quality practices (AI-generated test case review, test gap analysis)

**What do you need to bring:**

  
  

* 2-4 years of experience in software testing, with at least 1-2 years in mobile (Android and/or iOS) testing.
* Hands-on experience with Espresso and/or XCUITest, with willingness to learn the other.
* Good Java programming fundamentals and basic knowledge of data structures.
* Experience with API testing (Postman, RestAssured) and writing SQL queries.
* Good understanding of SDLC/STLC, test design, and defect management using JIRA and TestRail.
* Familiarity with Jenkins, BrowserStack, and debugging tools such as Logcat and the Xcode console.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work with developers and product managers.
* Ownership, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.
* Nice to have: Appium, Kotlin or Swift reading ability, mobile performance testing (Android Profiler, Xcode Instruments), JMeter, AWS, and experience in payments or FinTech.

**Subsidiary:**

PayPal

0

At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. Senior Test Automation Quality Engineer

Job summary

The Senior Test Automation Quality Engineer owns automated quality for a data platform and a data analytics platform. The platform keeps many partner integrations, and those integrations feed the dashboards and reports partners use. This role works with Engineering on requirements, designs, schedules, and release risk. The engineer uses AI coding agents in the Cursor and Claude ecosystem to speed up test authoring, review, and failure analysis, and keeps a human in the loop for assertions, coverage, and release decisions.

What you will do

* Design and maintain automated tests for partner integrations, the pipelines that land their data, and the dashboards and reports built from that data.
* Cover the path from source system to published report: ingest, transform, warehouse or lake, then the dashboard and report the partner sees. Include schema, row presence, freshness, and reconciliation across systems.
* Turn manual cases and acceptance criteria into stable automation in Java, Python, or Go. Use Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium for dashboard and report UI, and an API framework for integration and data services.
* Prove that a new or changed integration does not break existing partner dashboards and reports. Call out which reports, datasets, and partners a failure affects.
* Build these checks on AWS (for example S3, Glue, Athena, Lambda, Step Functions, and IAM) and against the warehouse the analytics platform uses.
* Use Cursor and Claude agents to draft tests, page objects, and triage notes from requirements and failures. Review every generated assertion before it is merged.
* Execute suites in CI, diagnose failures, and separate product defects from test defects and flakes. File defects with evidence: pipeline, query, dashboard, and report.
* Write and maintain test plans, cases, procedures, and release reports. Plan test scope against delivery dates when several integrations ship together.
* Review integration designs and report requirements for gaps, risk, and testability before build starts.
* Define quality gates for release readiness: an integration is not ready while its dashboards or reports are wrong, empty, or stale.
* Review historical results, call out regressions in shared datasets that fan out to many reports, and recommend changes to standards and coverage.
* Partner with Engineering and Quality Engineering in an agile delivery model. Explain findings so the team knows which partner experience is at risk.

What you bring

* Proven experience as a senior test automation or quality engineer, including ownership of suites through release.
* Experience on a data platform or analytics platform with multiple integrations, where partner dashboards and reports depend on that data.
* Proficiency with AI coding agents, specifically the Cursor and Claude ecosystem: skills, rules, prompts, and review of agent-written tests.
* Strong programming in at least one of Java, Python, or Go, and the ability to read the others.
* Hands-on UI automation with Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium, plus REST API automation.
* Solid AWS experience for data pipelines and analytics workloads. Secrets stay in a secret store, never in tests or logs.
* Experience testing web and API systems that depend on a database, warehouse, or lake.
* Skill in test design, defect isolation, and release reporting, with a high bar for assertion quality.
* Clear writing for test plans, bug reports, and quality summaries that name the affected reports and partners.

Preferred

* Experience with more than one UI tool (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium) or more than one language (Java, Python, Go).
* CI ownership (GitLab CI or GitHub Actions), including artifacts, quality gates, and pipeline triage.
* Hands-on checks for schema compare, row counts, and freshness, and for warehouses such as Snowflake or Athena.
* Experience validating scheduled or exported reports (PDF, email, or scheduled dashboard delivery), not only the on-screen dashboard.

At Mograsys Technologies, our Digital Engineering practice designs, builds, and scales modern software platforms that solve complex operational and technological challenges.

We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytically driven **Quality Assurance Engineer (Web & Mobile)** to join our development hub in Goa. In this role, you will be embedded directly within a fast-paced, collaborative agile engineering team, partnering closely with front-end engineers, backend architects, and product leads. You will take ownership of end-to-end quality validation across modern web apps, native/hybrid mobile products, and microservices, ensuring our enterprise solutions meet high benchmarks for performance, reliability, and user experience.

What You Will Do: Key Responsibilities1. Front-End Web Application Quality (React & Angular)

* Conduct rigorous functional and visual testing of responsive web applications built on modern frameworks (React.js, Angular).
* Validate state management logic, front-end routing, dynamic component behaviors, and form validations.
* Perform multi-browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari) and multi-breakpoint (desktop, tablet, mobile viewports) compatibility audits.
* Identify UI/UX defects, asset rendering issues, and client-side page load bottlenecks.

2. Mobile Application Testing (React Native / Hybrid & Native)

* Execute end-to-end testing cycles across physical devices and emulators for both Android and iOS environments.
* Validate mobile-specific features: gestures, navigation flows, hardware integrations, push notifications, deep links, and device permissions.
* Validate app performance across varying OS versions, fragmented screen resolutions, and changing network conditions (offline modes, 3G/4G/5G, network drops).
* Lead pre-release sanity checks, smoke runs, and app store deployment readiness verifications.

3. API & Backend Integration Validation

* Verify RESTful API contracts, data flows, and schema accuracy between user interfaces and backend services using Postman or similar tools.
* Validate API payload responses, HTTP status codes, error handling mechanisms, rate limits, and edge-case boundaries.
* Write and execute standard SQL queries to inspect relational database states, confirm data integrity, and validate end-to-end transaction persistence.

4. Test Automation & CI/CD Enablement

* Design, build, and maintain robust, reusable automated test suites for critical regression pathways.
* Leverage modern web automation frameworks (Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright) and mobile test drivers (Appium).
* Integrate test execution suites into CI/CD build pipelines to enable continuous testing, shorten release cycles, and maximize test coverage.

5. Defect Lifecycle, Agile Delivery & Quality Governance

* Log, classify, and track bugs through JIRA or Azure DevOps with unambiguous reproduction steps, screen captures, logs, and business-severity assessments.
* Partner directly with software engineers during sprint cycles to debug edge cases, isolate root causes, and retest bug fixes quickly.
* Actively contribute to Agile ceremonies—daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospective meetings—serving as the voice of product quality.

title: QA Engineer
description:
**About Ginesys**

Ginesys is India's leading retail technology platform, powering 1,200+ customers and 50,000+ users through the unified GinesysOne suite — ERP, Cloud POS (Zwing), Order Management (Browntape), GST Compliance (EaseMyGST), and BI (InsightX). We are evolving from a System of Records to a System of Intelligence through Ginesys.AI.

**About the role**
------------------

Ginesys Insights 2.0 is a self-service analytics platform for retail. Users build workbooks with pivot grids, charts and calculated measures, then share, schedule and export them as CSV, Excel or PDF. Every number must match the Ginesys ERP, and every customer must see only their own data.

We need a QA Engineer who can test both the **user experience** of the platform and the **correctness of the reports** built on it. You'll understand how data travels from the ERP database through the ingestion pipeline to each report, so you can tell a UI bug from a data or pipeline problem.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Platform UI and UX**

* Test the full user experience end to end:
* the workbook builder; grids, pivots, subtotals and grand totals; filters, drill-down and calculated measures; charts and dashboards;
* saved views, the content library and folders; sharing and access requests; scheduling and email delivery;
* CSV, XLSX and PDF exports; notifications; the admin screens.
* Check usability and compliance with the design system, responsive and mobile layouts, cross-browser behaviour, accessibility (WCAG), Indian number and date formatting, and the empty, loading, error and "stale data" states.

### **Reports and data correctness**

* Reconcile report numbers against **Ginesys ERP native reports** and the source **PostgreSQL** database using SQL.
* Cover sales, returns, net sales, footfall and conversion %, tender and payment collection, closing, transit and in-store stock position, and stock ageing.
* Check the edge cases: channel definitions (wholesale, retail POS, e-commerce, SOR/SIS); soft-deleted and cancelled transactions; as-of inventory carried forward between snapshots; division by zero; numeric precision and rounding; totals matching detail rows.
* Validate exported files against what is on screen.

### **Security and multi-tenancy**

* Test role-based access, row-level security (for example site restrictions), column masking, Viewer vs Contributor seats, certified vs custom content, and SSO session behaviour.
* Run negative tests to prove one customer can never see another customer's data.

### **Pipeline- and infrastructure-aware testing**

* Understand the data flow: ERP PostgreSQL, then Debezium/Kafka CDC, then the BigQuery raw layer, then Dataform silver and gold, then Cube and the backend, then the UI.
* Test data freshness: a change in the ERP should appear in the report within the agreed time. Also test late, updated and deleted records, and the effect of new source columns.
* Use Dataform assertion results, pipeline logs and Cloud Run logs to find where a defect starts. Confirm which build or revision is deployed in each environment before testing.

### **Automation, performance and release**

* Build and maintain automated tests:
* **Playwright** end-to-end tests for critical user journeys;
* API tests against the backend contract (Postman/Newman or REST Assured);
* SQL-based data-reconciliation checks, all running in **GitHub Actions**.
* Test performance with large result sets, deep paging, large exports, and query cost and size limits.
* Write test plans from the PRD and user stories, keep requirement-to-test traceability, triage defects in Jira, own the regression suite and give release sign-off.
* Support customer UAT during migration from the legacy BI tool, including report-parity checks.

**Must have**
-------------

* 3–6 years in software QA for web applications, with at least 1–2 years on **data-heavy, reporting or BI products**.
* **Strong SQL** (joins, aggregations, window functions, GROUP BY with totals) and the ability to reconcile numbers between a report and a database. PostgreSQL preferred.
* Hands-on testing of complex web UIs: data grids, pivots, filters, charts, exports. Cross-browser and responsive testing, with a good eye for usability.
* Test automation with **Playwright** (preferred), Cypress or Selenium, using TypeScript or JavaScript.
* API testing with Postman or REST Assured; reading JSON and HTTP status and error responses.
* Working understanding of **data pipelines**: ETL/ELT, change-data-capture, incremental loads, data freshness and data-quality checks.
* Basic understanding of **cloud infrastructure**: environments, deployments and releases, containers, reading application logs.
* Experience testing role-based access and multi-tenant applications.
* Test design techniques, Jira-based defect management, and clear written bug reports.

**Good to have**
----------------

* Google **BigQuery**; **Dataform** or dbt tests; **Cube.js** or other semantic layers.
* Basic Kafka/Debezium concepts; Google Cloud console (Cloud Run, Cloud Logging).
* Experience with BI tools (Exago, Qlik, Power BI, Tableau, Looker), especially report migration and parity testing.
* Retail or ERP domain knowledge: sales, returns, POS, inventory, stock ageing, GST. **Ginesys ERP** experience is a strong plus.
* Performance testing with k6 or JMeter; accessibility testing tools (axe, Lighthouse).
* ISTQB certification.
* Using AI assistants to generate and maintain tests, with careful review.

**What success looks like in 6 months**
---------------------------------------

* An automated regression suite (UI, API and data reconciliation) running in CI on every release.
* Report-parity sign-off with the ERP for the MVP metrics (sales, inventory and margin).
* Automated tenant-isolation and access-control tests gating releases.
* A defined data-freshness check from the ERP to the report.

**Benefits**:

We like to think that talent grows at Ginesys and stays at Ginesys. To ensure this, we provide our employees with the best working environment, the latest technology and continuous support. We go out of our way to retain the small business feeling with which we started and stimulate innovation and collaboration through teamwork and our non-hierarchical approach. We offer competitive salary, and other fantastic perks and benefits, such as:

Ginesys Academy for holistic training and development Comprehensive health insurance coverage Excellent rewards and recognition policy

Transparent compensation policy with no unnecessary deduction in CTC Annual company off-site and a variety of events, celebrations throughout the year

Travelling opportunities between our offices across the country. Annual Ginesys walkathon & related sporting events. Quarterly Coffee with the CEO and more!

**Here’s our story; now tell us yours**

Ginesys is India’s best omni retail suite backed by Ginesys, the first integrated Retail specific ERP software for online retail, offline retail and distribution. It is the largest Indian company in the retail tech industry catering to both online and offline needs. 1200 + brands including (Manyavar, V-Mart, Skechers) are accelerating their businesses with Ginesys. With a team of 400+ employees, Ginesys One plans to revolutionize retail by being a single-stop cloud-based retail suite. We have a pan India presence with offices in major cities including Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Coimbatore & Goa and are expanding rapidly. We love the challenges of retail and are busy solving them to create a great retail tech suite. Ginesys core mission is to continue to build world-class internal service capabilities, in a bid to deliver outstanding external service value to customers. We are an ISO-certified and SOC compliant company having won myriad awards for our innovation and support. For further information, please visit our websitehttp://ginesys.in/http://ginesys.in

title: Automation QA Engineer
description:
As an Automation QA Enginer at SkyCell, you'll shape how our team thinks about quality, working alongside developers and the design system team to catch problems early so everyone ships with confidence. You'll build with Playwright, test APIs and UI components, and help teammates grow their testing skills along the way. You don't need to match every point below to apply. If this sounds like work you'd enjoy, we'd love to hear from you.

**Location:** For this role, we can either consider fully remote or hybrid if you are located within a commutable distance to Hyderabad, India.

Founded in Switzerland in 2012, SkyCell is transforming global pharmaceutical supply chains through a combination of advanced temperature-controlled containers, IoT connectivity, and digital solutions.

Our integrated product ecosystem helps leading pharmaceutical companies reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and ensure the safe delivery of life-saving medicines worldwide.

Today, SkyCell operates at the intersection of hardware, software, data, and logistics - combining Swiss engineering excellence with a growing digital platform to shape the future of connected pharma supply chains.

**Why SkyCell?**

Purpose-Driven Work: Make a real difference by contributing to a more sustainable future in global logistics and healthcare.

Innovation at Heart: Work with cutting-edge technology and be at the forefront of supply chain innovation.

Stronger together: Join a supportive team of talented individuals from over 40 countries, where we work together every step of the way.

Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in our people – continuous learning and development are key pillars of SkyCell.

Award-Winning Culture: Join a workplace recognized for its commitment to excellence with a ‘Great Place to work’ award, as well as a Platinum Ecovadis rating highlighting our sustainability and employee well-being.

**What You'll Do:**

* Shape the test strategy with the team and advise on quality at every stage, from requirements to release
* Help write requirements and testable acceptance criteria, including for new UI components with the design system team
* Build and maintain automation frameworks, test suites and shared libraries in Playwright, plus test data tools in JavaScript / Node.js
* Test REST and GraphQL APIs (functional, contract and negative tests), covering authentication, error handling and data integrity. Set up contract testing (e.g., Pact) and check how services communicate through queues, webhooks and events
* Test our shared UI component library for visual regression, accessibility and cross-browser behaviour. Write unit and integration tests (Storybook, Testing Library) and make sure new releases don't break the apps that use them
* Support performance, availability and security testing with tools like k6, Artillery or JMeter
* Keep Jenkins pipelines healthy, fast and reproducible. Triage failed builds daily, tell product bugs apart from flaky tests and environment issues, and fix flaky tests at the root cause
* Run manual and regression tests, trace bugs to their root cause and work with developers on fixes
* Track and share quality metrics (coverage, pass rate, flakiness, build time) and keep test documentation, including Gherkin test cases, up to date
* Mentor teammates earlier in their careers and share QA best practices across the team

**What You'll Bring:**

* Experience building and maintaining test automation frameworks, ideally with Playwright and JavaScript / Node.js
* Experience testing REST/GraphQL APIs, including OAuth/JWT authentication, contract testing and SQL checks on database side effects
* Experience testing shared UI components with Testing Library, Storybook or Vitest/Jest
* Experience keeping CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins) reliable and tackling flaky tests
* Clear communication, curiosity about root causes, and strong written and spoken English

**Nice to have**

* Visual regression and accessibility testing experience
* Performance testing with k6, Artillery or JMeter
* Experience mentoring others

*If you don't meet every requirement but bring relevant experience, we'd still like to hear from you.*

**What's In It For You?**

* Flexibility & Balance: Flexible working hours and work-life balance allow you to tailor work to fit your life.

Recognition & Growth: Opportunities for career advancement in a company that values your contributions.

Hybrid Workplace: Modern workspaces (in Zurich, Zug and Hyderabad as well as our Skyhub in Basel) and a remote-friendly culture to inspire collaboration amongst a globally diverse team.

Company-wide Events: Join us for company events to celebrate successes, build teams, and share our vision. Plus, new joiners experience SkyWeek, our immersive onboarding program.

Generous Maternity & Paternity Leave: Support for new parents with competitive maternity and paternity leave.

️ Annual Leave & Bank Holidays: Enjoy a generous annual leave package, plus local bank holidays to recharge and unwind.

**Ready to Make an Impact?**

We’re not just offering a job; we’re offering a chance to be part of something bigger. At SkyCell, you’ll help build a future where pharmaceutical delivery is efficient, sustainable, and transformative.

**Stay Connected with SkyCell**

Visit http://www.skycell.ch and explore #WeAreSkyCell on LinkedIn

**How to Apply**

Simply click ‘apply for this job’ below! We can’t wait to meet you and discuss how you can contribute to our mission! Please note, we are unable to consider applications sent to us via email.

If you have any questions, you can contact our Talent Team (talent@skycell.ch).

*SkyCell AG is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.*

*For this position, if you are not located in, or able to relocate (without sponsorship) to one of the advertised locations, your application cannot be considered.*

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:**

**PREFERRED SKILLS:**

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:**

Sitero proudly offers an impressive compensation package and benefits, including a competitive salary, Variable pay, paid time off, and healthcare and retirement benefits.

Sitero is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes all job applicants. title: Engineer, Software Test Automation
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The e-Beam division plays a critical role in KLA’s inspection ecosystem, with tools that deliver high-resolution, timely insights into defects and critical locations on the wafer. Used alongside KLA’s patterned and bare wafer inspectors, e-Beam systems help our customers quickly identify and understand yield-impacting issues—enabling faster, more effective actions to correct the manufacturing process.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

  
  

Preferred to have a graduate or pos-graduate degree in Engineering/Science.

The selected Software QA Engineer will join a world-class software team to plan, manage, execute, and report results for all qualification activities for the PoR/team. He/She will be trained to be an effective team player and leader that will be responsible for the quality of all released products. He/She will be a strong process advocate with an acute attention to detail and desire to continually improve the Qualification process. He/She must be able to partner with other functional teams to resolve quality issues quickly.

**Key Responsibilities Include:**
---------------------------------

* Play role of **full stack test engineer for software of KLA Products**
* Qualification of new and existing products and features (functional/requirements based, regression, performance, reliability). This includes designing and qualifying, publishing results and recommendations in the form of training material, best known methods
* Ability to understand and develop test cases for products that use Deep Learning or machine learning Algorithms.
* Ability to technically interact with Algorithms, System Engineering, Application Engineering, Marketing and Manufacturing, Customer Support team for various requirements across the globe. Interact with cross locational teams.
* Automate the test cases and make them part of the CI pipeline for automatic execution
* Participate in all stages of software development including deployment/trouble shooting at customer sites. Represent SQE team in product life cycle and key program meetings

Travel to customer fabrication and MFG facilities to understand the system and its sub-systems, customer use cases, for deploying SW and troubleshooting.

**Minimum Qualifications**

Master's Level Degree or work experience of 0-2 years , Bachelor's Level Degree or work experience of 1-3 years

**About KLA**

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

  
  

**Use of AI Statement**

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.

  
  

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*

  

*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*
